prerequisites: It is essential to have completed the Fluid Mechanics Engineering course from the 1st semester of the 3rd year.

learning_outcomes.text: Applies the fundamentals of fluid-mechanical systems and machines.
Knows the operation and parameters of a pneumatic and oleohydraulic installation.
Poses and solves problems of piping systems. Performs the basic dimensioning and calculation of the fundamental parameters that characterize a fluid transport and distribution system.
Knows the classification, operation, and basic theory of hydraulic machines. Dimensions the functional parts of hydraulic machines.

syllabus_topics: Types of devices and selection factors for flow measurement devices
Venturi meter, orifice plate, and nozzle
Probes for velocity measurement: Pitot and Prandtl tube, anemometers
Types of conveyance problems: series and parallel systems
Class I systems. Calculation of unknown head. Practical cases
Class II systems. Flow rate calculation
Class III systems. Limiting value of losses and pipe diameter calculation
Types of pumps. Positive displacement pumps and kinetic pumps
Available NPSH and required NPSH. Cavitation
Centrifugal pump selection criteria. Requirements for suction and discharge lines. Applications
Positive displacement pumps. Applications. Principles of oleohydraulics
Air flow in ducts. Energy losses
Fan equations, affinity laws, and characteristic curves
Uniform flow. Chezy's formulas. Manning's correlation
Determination of depth. Rectangular and circular channels. Concept of efficient channel
teaching_methods: Introduction to the subject and general planning: information sources, evaluation calendar, standards required for monitoring the subject and good use of the course.
Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom from the list provided to prepare the subject.
Lectures on the specific contents of the subject (syllabus development). Practical aspects will be emphasized.
Personalized attention to facilitate monitoring of the course, feedback will be provided to each student through corrected exercises and doubt resolution.
assessment_rules: The minimum average mark required between the two partial exams, which will be weighted along with the assignments, is 3.5. In the second sitting (resit), the exam will account for 100% of the mark. Fraudulent completion of any evaluated activity using any means will result in a failing mark for that activity.
